extract bytes input from PDF document

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extract } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { bytes: await (await import("node:fs/promises")).readFile("pdf/fake_memo.pdf"), filename: "fake_memo.pdf", kind: ExtractInputKind.Bytes, mimeType: "application/pdf" };
  const result = await extract(input);
  console.log(result.results[0].mimeType);
  console.log(result.results[0].content);
}

void main();
```
